title: 第 21章 缔约第 22章 承诺
slug: 西幻从鹰人部落到天使帝国
content_zh:
十年后。
太古巨龙似乎知道了什么隐秘，全部隐匿起来，不见踪影。
而残余的泰坦巨人和地精之间，也快要撕破脸皮。
当今最强的泰坦巨人雷霆泰坦曾经想要亲自出手惩治背叛的地精一族，却在地精王庭的万里之外感觉到一股致命的威胁。
随即作罢！
他返回了泰坦祖地，帮助族人修养伤势。
大陆上如今近千万数量的地精全部围拢在地精王廷的周围，向地精之王阿米格尔效忠！
地精王廷对待散落在外的族人，可不像当初的鹰人王廷。
他们为族人提供食物，帮助他们选择居住地，培养他们的超凡职业者。
由此原本散落大陆，属于不同泰坦麾下的地精诸部归心，共同奉阿米格尔为王！
鹰人王庭、蛇人王庭、混血巨人族、半人马王庭等依旧忠诚于泰坦巨人族的种族们纷纷站出来怒斥地精的不忠，但却也改变不了地精强大起来的事实！
而出现在地精王廷之中的神秘人族则更为人所好奇。
聪明的人都猜到了，地精的迅速强大，和这些人族有着极为紧密的联系。
与此同时。
翼人一族在大陆的声名渐渐宣扬起来。
能够飞行长空的智慧种族，其实是比较稀少的。
尤其是翼人们几乎都是光明系的能力，职业体系中也拥有治愈的力量，更受大陆各族欢迎。
并且，在天空相遇时，翼人们比鹰人们更加强大。
因为他们如同人族一般的手，让他们能够使用弓箭，远程重创鹰人们。
而这个特点也让翼人弓箭手们成为费兰德最强大的兵种之一！

即便是超凡职业者，在面对成建制的翼人军团时，也会头疼不已。
这也让地精王庭注意到翼人的重要性！
当冬天的第一缕雪花飘洒在天堂山上，地精的使者如期而至！
天堂山。
一行相比费兰德大陆，打扮得十分“潮流”队伍登上了山顶。
在这支队伍里，除了身材矮小、四肢细长，浑身绿皮的地精之外，还有一个长相如同没有翅膀的翼人一般的人族！
当翼人士兵们带着地精的使团走向姜尤的大帐之时。
地精使者们充分展示了身为使者和费兰德大族的素养。
唯有那个人族女子，对和自己极为相似的翼人一族展现了足够的好奇心。
一路上东张西望，表情极为丰富。
来到姜尤居住的白石之堡。
地精使者们先是展示了一番对待异族之王的礼节，以手抚胸。
“尊敬的翼人之王，我们是由吾王阿米格尔派遣而来的使者，向您致以最真挚的敬意！”
姜尤同样站起身，洁白的双翼束于身后，紫色的眸子先是扫视了一番地精们，然后又看向了如同鹤立鸡群一般，站在地精之中的人族女孩，含笑道。
“欢迎你们，来自地精王庭的使者！”
他的确欢迎，同时也有些奇妙的感受。
眼前的地精们，穿戴整齐，身体收拾的十分干净，和第五篇章中的那些经常见到的，只能苟延残喘在荒野的地精们有本质区别！
content_en:
Ten years later.
The ancient dragon seemed to know some secrets, and all of them hid themselves without a trace.
And the remaining Titans and Goblins are about to be at odds with each other.
The strongest Titan today, Thunder Titan, once wanted to personally punish the rebellious goblins, but he felt a fatal threat thousands of miles away from the goblin royal court.
Give up immediately!
He returned to the Titan ancestral land to help his tribe recover from their injuries.
There are now nearly tens of millions of goblins on the mainland gathered around the goblin royal court and loyal to the goblin king Amiguel!
The Goblin King's treatment of the scattered tribesmen is not like the original Eagle Man's King's treatment.
They provide food for the people, help them choose a place to live, and train their extraordinary professions.
As a result, the goblin tribes that were originally scattered across the continent and belonged to different titans returned to their hearts and jointly worshiped Armiger as their king!
Races that are still loyal to the Titans, such as the Eagle Court, the Snake Court, the Hybrid Giants, the Centaur Court, and other races who are still loyal to the Titans have come out and angrily denounced the goblins for their disloyalty, but they cannot change the fact that the goblins have become stronger!
The mysterious human race that appeared in the goblin court is even more curious.
Smart people have guessed that the rapid power of goblins is closely related to these human races.
at the same time.
The reputation of the Yiren clan in the mainland gradually spread.
Intelligent races that can fly across the sky are actually relatively rare.
In particular, Winged people almost all have light-based abilities, and their professional system also has the power of healing, making them more popular among all races in the mainland.
Moreover, when they meet in the sky, the Winged People are more powerful than the Eagle People.
Because their human-like hands allow them to use bows and arrows to severely damage the hawks from a distance.
And this characteristic also makes the Winged Archers one of the most powerful units in Ferland!
Even extraordinary professionals will have a headache when facing an organized winged army.
This also made the Goblin Royal Court pay attention to the importance of wingmen!
When the first snowflakes of winter fall on Heavenly Mountain, the goblin messenger arrives as scheduled!
Paradise Mountain.
A group of people who were dressed more "fashionably" than those in Flanders climbed to the top of the mountain.
In this team, in addition to the short stature, slender limbs, and green-skinned goblins, there is also a human race who looks like a winged man without wings!
When the Yiren soldiers led the goblin envoy towards Jiang You's tent.
The goblin envoys fully demonstrated their qualities as envoys and the Flanders family.
Only the human woman showed enough curiosity about the Winged people who were very similar to herself.
Along the way, I looked around with very rich expressions.
Arrive at the White Stone Castle where Jiang You lives.
The goblin envoys first showed some etiquette towards the foreign king and put their hands on their chests.
"Dear King of Winged Men, we are the envoys sent by our King Amiguel, and we would like to extend our most sincere respect to you!"
Jiang You also stood up, with his pure white wings tied behind him. His purple eyes first glanced at the goblins, and then looked at the human girl standing among the goblins like a bird standing out from the crowd, and said with a smile.
"Welcome, envoys from the Goblin Court!"
He did welcome it, but also had some strange feelings.
The goblins in front of me are neatly dressed and their bodies are very clean. They are fundamentally different from the goblins we often see in Chapter 5 who can only linger in the wilderness!
